snippet.title: Venaitura Trailer
snippet.description:
VENAITURA is a turn-based, retro-styled RPG wherein you assemble a party of 4 Heroes from 12 Classes and embark on a journey to rid Tsufana of the titular tower's corruption.

Now available to Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664240/Venaitura/


Steam/RMN Page Design and Game Trailer by Karimn "Mirak" DKI - (world-on-pixels.itch.io).
